what_happened: Task description's defect-class-2 evidence (lean opencode-agents.json path bug) claimed .opencode/agent/subagents/lean-research-agent.md and lean-implementation-agent.md 'ALREADY EXIST on disk' as of the 2026-08-24 pass. The directory composition this task's evidence rests on has drifted since it was last measured.

Research report explicitly deferred one design question to the planner (whether spam gating belongs inside generate_opencode_json or needs a reload-level wrapper). Reading manager.resync_all's per-extension manager.load loop plus the two generate_opencode_json call sites in shared/extensions/init.lua answered it directly at plan time and changed the chosen design: a per-invocation summary would still emit one notification per extension, so aggregation was placed at the resync_all caller level instead. Cost ~3 tool calls and avoided planning an approach that would not have met the acceptance criterion.
git-commit-phase.sh dropped 'agent-system/extensions/core/docs/docs-README.md' from a phase commit pathspec: not contained in this task's declared file_scope.

Phase 6's narrowed gate run (--only-gate 4,5) found gate5 FAIL: .claude/docs/docs-README.md (deployed) differs from agent-system/extensions/core/docs/docs-README.md (source store), because Phase 2 edited the source-store copy per the source-store-deploy-boundary rule but no redeploy has run since. This is expected, self-resolving drift: the task's own 'modified_files' includes an agent-system/extensions/** path, which triggers the Inter-Cycle Redeploy Checkpoint at the /orchestrate batch level (see context/patterns/batch-orchestration-guardrails.md's 'The Inter-Cycle Redeploy Checkpoint' section) -- that checkpoint runs deploy-headless.sh and re-verifies after this dispatch returns, which will resolve the drift. Not treated as a defect in this phase's own work; recorded for traceability.
